name: Back squat
cues: Brace hard and keep the bar over mid-foot
Sit between the hips and drive knees out
Stop at the depth you can control

name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold the weight close to your chest
Keep chest tall and elbows inside the knees
Sit down between the feet, heels flat

name: Leg press
cues: Feet shoulder width, mid-height on the platform
Lower until the hips start to tuck
Don't lock out hard at the top

name: Bodyweight squat
cues: Feet about shoulder width, toes slightly out
Reach hips back and down
Pause at the bottom, then stand tall

name: Split squat
cues: Long stride, back foot light on the floor
Drop the back knee straight down
Keep torso upright and front heel down

name: Reverse lunge
cues: Step back and lower the back knee toward the floor
Front shin stays close to vertical
Push through the front heel to stand

name: Trap bar deadlift
cues: Stand in the centre and grip the handles
Push the floor away with chest up
Lock out with glutes, don't lean back

name: Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push the hips back
Bar stays close to the legs the whole way
Stop at mid-shin or when the back starts to round

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Hold dumbbells in front of the thighs
Hinge at the hips and keep the spine neutral
Feel the stretch in the hamstrings

name: Hip thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, bar over the hips
Drive through the heels and squeeze at the top
Chin tucked and ribs down

name: Glute bridge
cues: Feet flat, knees bent, heels close to hips
Drive hips up and squeeze the glutes
Lower with control and don't arch the back

name: Kettlebell swing
cues: Hinge and snap the hips forward
Arms are ropes, the power comes from the hips
Keep the back flat and the bell at chest height

name: Barbell bench press
cues: Retract and depress the shoulder blades
Lower the bar to mid-chest with forearms vertical
Keep elbows about 45 degrees from the torso

name: Dumbbell floor press
cues: Lie on the floor, elbows touch it at the bottom
Press up with control and wrists stacked
Keep elbows tucked, not flared

name: Push-up
cues: Hands just outside the shoulders, body in a line
Lower the chest to just above the floor
Push the floor away with elbows at about 45 degrees

name: Dip
cues: Lean slightly forward to load the chest
Lower until upper arms are about parallel to the floor
Stop short if the front of the shoulder pinches

name: Barbell overhead press
cues: Bar starts at the collarbone, grip just outside the shoulders
Squeeze glutes and press straight over mid-foot
Move the head back, then through at lockout

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
cues: Seated or standing with ribs down
Press in a slight arc with biceps by the ears
Lower to shoulder height with control

name: Landmine press
cues: Split stance, bar end in hand at the shoulder
Press up and forward along the bar's arc
Keep the core tight and don't shrug

name: Pike push-up
cues: Hips high, hands wider than the shoulders
Lower the top of the head toward the floor
Press back up with elbows pointing back

name: Barbell row
cues: Hinge to about 45 degrees with the back flat
Pull the bar to the lower ribs, elbows back
Control the bar down, don't yank it

name: Chest-supported row
cues: Chest on an incline bench, arms hanging
Pull elbows toward the hips and squeeze the shoulder blades
Pause briefly at the top

name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: Knee and hand on the bench, back flat
Drive the elbow up past the torso
Lower fully for a complete stretch

name: Seated cable row
cues: Sit tall with a slight lean and no rocking
Pull the handle to the belly button
Let the shoulder blades move forward at full stretch

name: Inverted row
cues: Body straight from heels to head
Pull the chest toward the bar
Lower until the arms are straight

name: Face pull
cues: Rope at upper-chest height
Pull toward the forehead with elbows high and out
Rotate the hands out at the end of each rep

name: Band pull-apart
cues: Arms straight at shoulder height
Pull the band apart toward the chest
Keep wrists neutral and shoulders down

name: Lat pulldown
cues: Grip just wider than the shoulders
Pull the bar to the upper chest with chest tall
Control the bar back up to a full stretch

name: Pull-up
cues: Hang with full arm extension
Pull the chest toward the bar, elbows down
Lower slowly to a dead hang

name: Kipping pull-up
cues: Use a controlled hip swing to start
Pull hard and push the bar down at the end
Stop if the shoulder pinches

name: Behind-the-neck pulldown
cues: Wide grip, pull the bar behind the neck
Upright torso and a small range of motion
Skip it if the shoulder is sore overhead

name: Upright row
cues: Grip narrower than the shoulders
Lead with the elbows, bar close to the body
Stop at chest height if the shoulders pinch

name: Farmer carry
cues: Tall posture with shoulders down and back
Short, quick steps and no swinging weights
Squeeze the handles hard the whole time

name: Plank
cues: Elbows under the shoulders, body in a line
Squeeze the glutes and brace the stomach
Breathe steadily and don't let the hips sag

name: Dead bug
cues: Keep the lower back pressed into the floor
Extend the opposite arm and leg slowly
Exhale as you extend

name: Pallof press
cues: Stand side-on to the cable and hold at the chest
Press out and resist the twist
Hold for two seconds, then return

name: Dumbbell curl
cues: Elbows pinned at your sides
Curl up without swinging the torso
Lower slowly for about three seconds

name: Triceps pushdown
cues: Elbows tucked and fixed in place
Extend fully and squeeze at the bottom
Let the forearms return under control

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
cues: Slight bend in the elbows, lead with the elbows
Raise to shoulder height and no higher
Lower slowly and don't let the weights drop

name: Leg extension
cues: Line the knee up with the machine's pivot
Extend fully and pause at the top
Lower with control and no bouncing

name: Seated leg curl
cues: Pad sits just above the heel
Curl the heels toward the glutes
Return slowly and don't let the stack slam

name: Standing calf raise
cues: Rise onto the balls of the feet
Pause at the top and squeeze the calf
Lower into a full stretch
